summary: Client state of the tutorial UI layers: one entity per layer id, filled by ecl::tutorial::UILayerSystem::Update from the requests queued through UILayerSystem::LEGACY_Request(short, UILayerRequest) (UILayerRequest = two FixedStrings and a bool). Seen idle in CTY/BGO and when using the level swap teleporter and the elevator to the Underdark (born together with ecl::tutorial::UILayerChangedOneFrameComponent).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0x638E00 UILayerSystem::Update: FixedString::operator=(element, request+0) for requests whose bool at +8 is 0 (8-byte elements: size*8 stride); macOS UILayerRequest::UILayerRequest sets it to FixedString::Empty

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: same function: FixedString::operator=(element+4, request+4); this value is also inserted into the set at +0x18

fields.name: Layer
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0x638E00: when a layer entity is created, *component = the short key of the system's request list (LEGACY_Request(short, ...)); bg3.exe+0x1ABEDA0 (add helper, 0x48 bytes) zeroes it; live 1

fields.name: Entries
fields.evidence: Update appends 8-byte elements to the Array at +8 (count +0x14, capacity +0x10) and copies two FixedStrings into each; live capacity 1, size 0/1

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Update clears and refills the set at +0x18 (keys at +0x38 read with a 4-byte stride as FixedString, count +0x44) with the second FixedString of each entry (FUN_1805a1de0(comp+0x18, .., element+4)); bg3.exe+0x1ABEDA0 zeroes +0x18..+0x47; live buckets 5, keys 1/0..1

open_questions: meaning of the two FixedStrings of an entry (element/widget names?) and of the set
